name: angular-developer
title_zh: Angular 官方技能，生成代码前先讲架构取舍
tagline_zh: 从组件到 SSR 全覆盖，但最值钱的是它会在你写 signal 或路由前，先问你要不要换一种更简单的结构。
tagline_en: Covers components to SSR, but the real value: it questions your architecture before you write that signal or route.
desc_en: Generates Angular code and provides architectural guidance. Trigger when creating projects, components, services, or HTTP communication, or for best practices on reactivity (signals, linkedSignal, resource, httpResource), forms, dependency injection, routing, SSR, accessibility (ARIA), animations, styling (component styles, Tailwind CSS), testing, naming conventions, or CLI tooling.
why_zh: 不是代码补全，是带规范的架构师——先确认你的场景再给方案，避免你写出能跑但难维护的 Angular。
why_en: Not autocomplete—an architect with rules. It checks your context before proposing code, so you don't ship maintainability debt.
limit_zh: 只认 Angular 技术栈，不碰 React/Vue；产物是代码与建议，不含测试运行或构建验证；需要你已有项目结构。
limit_en: Angular only—no React/Vue. Outputs code & advice, not test runs or builds. Needs an existing project; on blank slate it interrogates you first.
title_en: Official Angular skill: architecture first, code second
